standard.summary: Soft Tokens 是按 layer/timestep 插入的可学习文本 token。Lulynx 只保留当前 SoftREPA-style 路线，旧 AGSM/dispersive 方案不默认恢复。
standard.effect: token bank 会 prepend 到文本条件，并同步扩展 attention mask。
standard.whenToUse: 后续需要轻量补强文本条件、风格提示或 layer-aware conditioning 时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要可静态合并到模型权重的 LoRA；Soft Tokens 是 live conditioning state。

standard_en.summary: Soft Tokens are learnable text tokens inserted per layer or per timestep. Lulynx keeps only the current SoftREPA-style route; the old AGSM/dispersive scheme is not restored by default.
standard_en.effect: The token bank is prepended to the text conditioning, and the attention mask is extended to match.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you later want to reinforce the text conditioning lightly, add a style hint, or do layer-aware conditioning.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need a LoRA that can be merged statically into the model weights; Soft Tokens are live conditioning state.

advanced.principle: 根据 layer 和 timestep 选择 token bank，将 learnable tokens 拼到文本 embedding 前面。
advanced.intervention: Text conditioning path → attention mask expansion → future checkpoint metadata。
advanced.expectedImpact: 会增加文本 token 长度和少量 attention 成本；训练效果需要 。
advanced.tradeoffs: AGSM/dispersive 模式已明确拒绝，避免复活上游移除路径。

advanced_en.principle: Selects a token bank by layer and timestep and prepends the learnable tokens to the text embedding.
advanced_en.intervention: Text conditioning path → attention mask expansion → future checkpoint metadata.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Increases text token length and a small attention cost; training effect needs .
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The AGSM/dispersive modes are explicitly rejected, avoiding revival of upstream-removed paths.
